title: DomainLexiconEntryV1
description: Standardized schema for domain-specialized technical vocabulary entries, cross-lingual English-to-Nepali alignment, anti-jargon rules, and register calibration.

domain.description: Field or discipline for the technical jargon.

definition_en.description: Functional, non-hype definition (10-25 words defining what it is and mechanically does).

register.description: Target tone register matching Claude engineering standard.

banned_alternatives.description: Inflated marketing buzzwords, vague analogies, or hype terms strictly forbidden when describing this concept.

canonical_usage_en.description: Exemplary sentence demonstrating calm authority and functional precision.

scope_boundary_en.description: Explicit statement declaring what this term or system does NOT imply or perform.

policy_tier.description: Tier 1: Established native term; Tier 2: Loanword transliterated to Devanagari; Tier 3: Invariant English acronym or mathematical symbol.

canonical_rendering.description: Recommended rendering in technical Nepali prose.

transliteration_devanagari.description: Devanagari phonetic rendering (e.g., ब्याकप्रोपोगेशन, जनसांख्यिकीय समानता).

context_sentence_ne.description: Exemplary technical sentence in Nepali showing natural syntactic framing.

archaic_sanskrit_anti_pattern.description: Hyper-formal Sanskritized neologism to avoid due to practitioner alienation.
